entries.normative_statement: M0 SHALL NOT be required to implement later HTTP protocol functionality.
entries.decision_rationale: This explicitly constrains M0 scope; HTTP protocol implementation is not an M0 exit prerequisite.

entries.normative_statement: M0 SHALL avoid decisions that make mandatory later requirements impossible without unjustified redesign.
entries.decision_rationale: This is an M0 architecture-compatibility obligation; a controlled architecture review is still needed.

entries.normative_statement: M0 exit SHALL identify every M0-owned requirement and its qualification status.
entries.decision_rationale: This explicitly requires a complete M0-owned requirement set with individual qualification results at M0 exit.

entries.normative_statement: M0 SHALL establish automated detection of duplicate or unknown requirement identifiers.
entries.decision_rationale: This explicitly requires automated identifier rejection at M0; positive and adversarial identity tests are present.

entries.normative_statement: M0 SHALL establish a reproducible mechanism for identifying the binary under qualification.
entries.decision_rationale: This explicitly requires reproducible binary identification at M0; the configuration verifier supplies build-specific binary identity evidence.
